observations.content: Verified fix/cache-race-condition branch: all 14 tests pass (10 unit + 4 concurrency). Implementation uses per-key mutex locking (KeyLock class), version stamping, and three write strategies (set, setIfVersion, update). The race condition from the issue — stale read-then-write under concurrent PUT — is eliminated by the atomic update() method.
No git remote is configured on this local repo, so a PR cannot be opened. The branch fix/cache-race-condition has 3 commits ahead of master and is ready to push once a remote is added.

This repo has been worked on by two prior sessions that fully implemented and verified the fix. The implementation and test suite are production-quality. Future sessions should check .squad/memory/inbox/ for prior work before re-implementing.
